page_title: HOF 1-4 BAY | Hoffenheim v Bayern Munich 20/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's it for today, Robert Hartmann has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+9' 1 - 4 Goal! Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:4.
90+8' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only crashes against the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.

90+8' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the crossbar. However, he couldn't beat Oliver Baumann, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
90+5' Great save! Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Oliver Baumann.
90+3' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
90+2' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.

90+2' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Robert Hartmann no option but to blow his whistle. Bayern Munich get a free kick.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
88' The attendance for today's match is 30150.
86' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Tom Bischof comes onto the pitch to replace him.
83' Christian Ilzer prepares a substitution. Leon Avdullahu is replaced by Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim).
83' Substitution. Vladimir Coufal makes his way off the pitch and Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) comes on as his replacement.
82' 1 - 3 Goal! The free-kick is fired in by Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) and the ball inadvertently flicks off a defender and spins into the net, leaving Manuel Neuer stranded. 1:3.
81' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) makes a rough challenge and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle for a foul.
78' Here is a change. Fisnik Asllani is going off and Christian Ilzer gives the last tactical orders to Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) is coming onto the pitch as Wouter Burger cannot continue after picking up an injury.

77' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is going to take the penalty!
76' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Bayern Munich!

72' One of the players from Bayern Munich times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

68' The game is interrupted now, Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
67' The manager makes a subsitution with Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) coming on for Muhammed Damar.
65' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

58' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) sees his long-range effort blocked.
58' Hoffenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

51' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayern Munich.

46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' The corner by Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

45+3' The ball falls for Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim) in the box, and he hits a first-time shot at goal that is inadvertently blocked by a defender. A bit unlucky there! Hoffenheim will take a corner kick.
45+2' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Robert Hartmann blows for a foul.

45+1' He should have scored! Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Oliver Baumann makes an easy save.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

44' 0 - 1 Lennart Karl produces a cross from the resulting corner and finds Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) inside the box. He pulls the trigger and scores, sending the ball inside the right post. What a brilliant finish. 0:1.

36' Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

33' Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
29' Robert Hartmann shows a yellow card to Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) for his blatant foul.
28' Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
28' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Hoffenheim.
27' Neat passing move from Bayern Munich in order to create new attacking opportunities.

24' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
24' Hoffenheim earn a corner.
23' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.

22' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
20' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
18' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayern Munich comes to nothing.
18' The Bayern Munich players can’t believe it after referee Robert Hartmann signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
17' Referee Robert Hartmann makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Bayern Munich. Let’s see what happens!
16' A quickly taken corner by Bayern Munich.

16' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Oliver Baumann pulls off an easy save. Corner kick. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity.
15' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) squanders a golden opportunity after striking the ball onto the post of the goal!

13' The cross into the penalty area from Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
12' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Hartmann had an easy-decision to make.
